topic_title: Environmental Hazards — Low-Water, Fog, Ice & Wind
prompt: How should a driver adjust when facing blinding sunrise or sunset sun glare along east-west highways?

options.text: Close both eyes intermittently for five seconds to rest sensitive optic nerves
Use sunglasses/visor, keep windshield clean, reduce speed, expand following gap
Turn off headlights so oncoming vehicles are not confused by excess light
Speed up to pass under overhead bridge overpasses where shadows offer shelter
